What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻‍‍

Having found an early product-market fit in a nascent, rapidly growing space, we’re scaling our Ratings Team at pace to support our carbon data platform. We’re looking for a mission-driven analyst to conduct carbon project assessments and help build our expert assessment frameworks ensuring that everything we do is built on robust and comprehensive data and analysis. It’s a critical role at the heart of our business - you’ll work within a large team of multidisciplinary analysts, working together to leverage all the skills and insights necessary to drive value for our customers. You will report to our Nature-Based Solutions Lead.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting carbon project assessments, providing deep due diligence on carbon projects focussed on providing value to the customer through timely and robust data and insights

  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative research, such as assessing project documentation, scientific literature, news reports, modelling formulas, time series data, and geospatial data

  • Contributing toward process improvement initiatives and the design of systems and tooling to improve the speed and quality of our assessments

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the business, notably in technology, data, product, commercial teams

  • Ensuring that critical quality assurance processes are upheld to maintain our status as the markets most trusted data provider with our carbon project assessments

  • Promote and uphold best practices in the team, including keeping customer value at the heart of what we do

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Based in London (this role is on-site, with five days a week in our London office)

  • Has deep critical thinking skills and the ability to apply logical principles in order to quickly determine actionable solution pathways to complex problems

  • Has experience delivering data insights as well as innovating new analytics

  • Has established knowledge of quantitative analysis techniques and high familiarity with common quantitative tools for example Sheets, GIS software, SQL, Python, etc.

  • Excellent English written communication and collaboration skills

  • Fast learner, self-starter, intellectually curious, quantitative and ready to get up-to-speed in a complex and technical domain

  • Takes initiative, excellent time-management skills, and adapts easily to change especially when operating toward deadlines

  • Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

  • Cares deeply about the climate and ecosystems of the Earth

  • Additional language skills in Spanish, Portuguese or Japanese are advantageous

  • We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description

Benefits 💰

- Equity in a rapidly growing startup

- Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

- Unlimited annual leave - and encouragement to actually use it!

- Enhanced parental leave

- Up to 20 days paid sick leave

- No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job

- Access to Mental Health support

- Monthly team socials

Location 🌍

- London, Old Street.

Our values 🙌

  • Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

  • Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

  • Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

  • Collaborate with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

  • Empower Customers - Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit and positivity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

Having proven product market fit, we are now looking for a mission-driven, top performing, Account Executive to join our commercial function. This key position on our LatAm sales team will help us scale our presence across the continent, driving further market penetration and presence in the region. You will increase Sylvera's revenue by helping our customers solve fundamental challenges.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across prospective enterprise and mid-market customers in your assigned territory

  • Develop and execute outbound strategies to create pipeline and nurture opportunities

  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close

  • Establish and grow relationships with multiple stakeholders within our prospects to drive opportunities to close

  • Become a technical expert and point of reference for our customers and prospects in the market

  • Leverage internal resources and cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales Engineering, Product Managers) to move deals forward

  • Provide quality feedback from prospects to our product team

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has 5+ years of closing experience selling complex solutions as a top performer, successfully meeting and exceeding sales quota

  • Has previously sold subscription based services (SaaS or similar)

  • Has previously sold sustainability solutions in South American markets and brings an existing network

  • Is trained in best in class sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, Jolt, Command of the Message, or similar) and has a creative approach to selling and pipeline generation

  • Maintain consistent Salesforce hygiene, including accurate and up to date pipeline

  • Can travel for prospect visits and attend relevant events

  • Hunter mentality, generating and qualifying opportunities from scratch by themselves

  • Highly curious on helping solve customer problems

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and confident in exercising good judgement

  • Has a hunger to learn, be coached and become a world-class salesperson

  • Cares deeply about the climate and ecosystems of the earth

We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Location 🌍

Sao Paulo

 

Benefits 💰

- Equity in a rapidly growing startup

- Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

- Unlimited annual leave - and encouragement to actually use it!

- 4 weeks/year work from anywhere

- Enhanced parental leave

- Up to 20 days paid sick leave

- No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job

- Access to Mental Health support

- Monthly team socials

 
 

Our Values 🙌

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

 

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

 

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

Sylvera is seeking an experienced Regulatory Compliance Officer in Ireland to play a critical role in supporting our compliance framework in connection with the ESMA EU ESG Ratings Regulation.

Reporting to the Head of Legal, you will be responsible for embedding and maintaining the governance arrangements expected of an authorised ESG rating provider, supporting Sylvera’s ongoing regulatory obligations, working closely with the global team to address regulatory issues and ensure compliance.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Advise senior management and the board on regulatory compliance matters and provide regular compliance reporting;

  • Act as a primary point of contact with ESMA and manage regulatory correspondence, notifications and information requests;

  • Monitor developments in the ESG Ratings Regulation, associated Delegated Regulations and ESMA guidelines, and assess their impact on Sylvera;

  • Develop, maintain and enforce compliance policies, procedures and monitoring programmes, including periodic assessments;

  • Maintain appropriate records to demonstrate compliance to ESMA on request;

  • Identify, manage, mitigate and disclose actual and potential conflicts of interest and maintain a conflicts of interest register;

  • Deliver training to relevant staff on regulatory obligations and policies and monitor compliance internally; and

  • Promote a culture of compliance across the Irish entity and the wider Sylvera group.

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • A minimum of 3-5 years' relevant compliance experience

  • Is based in Ireland.

  • Experience developing a regulatory framework within a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • Working knowledge of the ESMA regulatory framework applicable to ESG ratings including governance, conflicts-of-interest and internal-control requirements.

  • Experience analysing, assessing and managing regulatory and compliance risks.

  • Experience designing and implementing effective systems and controls for regulatory and governance.

  • Experience of engaging with a regulator.

  • Strong drafting, verbal, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating with a global team.

  • Familiarity with the voluntary carbon market and/or ESG data and analytics is desirable.

We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Benefits 💰

- Equity in a rapidly growing startup

- Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

- Unlimited annual leave - and encouragement to actually use it!

- Enhanced parental leave

- Up to 20 days paid sick leave

- No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job

- Access to Mental Health support

- Monthly team socials

 

Location 🌍

Ireland (Remote)

Our values 🙌

  • Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

  • Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

  • Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

  • Collaborate with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

With product-market fit proven, we're looking for a mission-driven, top-performing enterprise seller to join our commercial team. This is a key role on our EMEA team: you'll scale our presence across Europe, drive deeper market penetration, and grow Sylvera's revenue by helping customers solve fundamental challenges.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Build and own a territory across enterprise and mid-market prospects

  • Become a technical expert and trusted point of reference for customers and prospects

  • Generate net-new opportunities and close new business

  • Develop and execute outbound strategies to build and nurture pipeline

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first touch to close

  • Build and grow relationships with multiple stakeholders to drive deals over the line

  • Bring the voice of the customer back to our product team

We're looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has 3+ years of closing experience selling complex solutions as a top performer, consistently meeting and exceeding quota

  • Has sold into multiple European markets and brings an existing network

  • Sells with a structured but creative approach: you generate your own pipeline, qualify from scratch, build champions, and navigate complex org structures

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and confident exercising sound judgement

  • Is hungry to learn, be coached, and become a world-class seller

  • Can travel regularly for client visits and events

  • Is genuinely curious about solving customer problems

  • Cares deeply about the climate and the earth's ecosystems

We'd like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Location 🌍

London - Hybrid

 
 

Benefits 💰

- Equity in a rapidly growing startup

- Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

- Unlimited annual leave - and encouragement to actually use it!

- 4 weeks/year work from anywhere

- Enhanced parental leave

- Up to 20 days paid sick leave

- Monthly team socials

 
 

Our Values 🙌

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

 

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

 

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

We’re looking for a mission-driven Product Manager to join our Product function and help scale the value of Sylvera’s live products. You’ll take products that have found market fit and make them great - taking them from 1 to 2, rather than 0 to 1.

This is a high-impact role. You’ll be trusted to own your areas and expected to execute autonomously, and we’ll invest in you to set you up for success. You’ll join our product guild, and learn from passionate and experienced colleagues who are enthusiastic about sharing knowledge.

Specific responsibilities will include:
